result.description:
MedicalJobsAustralia.com     Your role at St John of God Bunbury Hospital

St John of God Bunbury Hospital is seeking an experienced and motivated Deputy Combined Facilities Manager to join our team at the South West Health Campus. In this key leadership role, you will support the management and maintenance of the site's assets and infrastructure, ensuring they remain safe, reliable, and fit for purpose.

Working closely with the Combined Facilities Manager, you will help ensure all facilities and essential services meet operational requirements, regulatory standards, and licensing obligations. You will drive best-practice asset management strategies, optimise performance and reliability, and support the delivery of cost-effective facilities services that contribute to exceptional patient care and hospital operations.

The role is offered on a Permanent Full-Time basis, working 76 hours per fortnight.

The Position:

Demonstrate Lead the maintenance and reliability of critical hospital infrastructure and essential services, ensuring assets are safe, compliant, and operational through risk-based preventative maintenance and best-practice asset management.

Coordinate maintenance activities, contractors, and compliance requirements, including job planning, resource management, permit administration, documentation control, CMMS (MEX) management, and the resolution of plant and system breakdowns.

Monitor and optimise critical building services and asset performance, including HVAC, water, air quality, and medical gas systems, through effective use of the BMS and CMMS, KPI reporting, preventative maintenance, and continuous improvement initiatives.

Drive maintenance planning, compliance, and operational excellence by managing asset data, service contracts, shutdowns, training, documentation, audits, and reliability improvement programs to ensure safe, efficient, and compliant hospital operations

Support team leadership and operational planning by facilitating regular team meetings and assisting with budget development, capital works planning, and asset replacement strategies.

Ensure compliance and governance standards are met through adherence to organisational policies, regulatory requirements, licensing obligations, and workplace health, safety, and fire regulations.

The successful candidate will hold a relevant trade qualification and bring proven experience in a similar facilities or engineering role. They will possess extensive knowledge of building codes, Australian Standards, and hospital engineering services, including HVAC, boilers, steam systems, sterilisation processes, and a broad understanding of mechanical, plumbing, refrigeration, electrical, and building services trades. Experience using a Computerised Maintenance Management System (CMMS) and preparing maintenance documentation and reports is essential.

You will be a strong communicator with the ability to build effective stakeholder relationships and reliable professional networks. Demonstrated problem-solving skills, the ability to analyse and resolve complex technical issues, and a commitment to high-quality service delivery are essential.

The role requires participation in an after-hours on-call roster and the ability to obtain nomination on the hospital's in-house Electrical Licence if not already held.

Above all, patient care will be at the core of everything you do committing to and supporting our Mission and Values.

We can offer you

Highly competitive renumeration

Permanent full-time position

Salary packaging up to $18,550 on a range of benefits such as mortgage, rent, meal entertainment, holiday accommodation or other everyday living expenses as well as options to salary package benefits above the FBT cap on items such as:

Novated leasing 

work related expenses

self-education and

additional superannuation

A healthy work-life balance through flexible work options, additional purchased leave & well-being programs

Employee discount on St John of God Hospital & Medical Services and Private Health Insurance

Employee support through our dedicated free Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

Innovative Professional Development opportunities

A welcoming and supportive culture

Dynamic multidisciplinary team

14 weeks Paid Parental Leave (WA)

For enquiries contact, Corey Baker, Combined Facilities Manager, on (08) 9722 1950

Position may be filled before closing date if a suitable candidate is identified

Please note: If suitable candidates are identified, shortlisting and interviews may begin before the advertisement closes.

At St John of God Health Care, we celebrate diversity and warmly welcome applications from people of all backgrounds. 

Our commitment is to create a safe and nurturing environment for all children and vulnerable individuals in our care and proactively take steps to protect them from abuse, ensuring their safety and well-being. 

Our inclusive culture fosters an environment that is respectful and secure, welcoming and accessible, and unified through our diverse community.    Click here to Apply now →

result.description:
Your new company     
 Join a globally recognised engineering and industrial services organisation with a strong presence across Australia and a reputation for delivering high-performance solutions within the energy, mining, and heavy industrial sectors. 
   
 With a long history of innovation and technical excellence, the business specialises in compressor and rotating equipment services, supporting critical infrastructure for major clients. You'll be part of a company that values safety, reliability, and continuous improvement, backed by global expertise and local execution. 
   Your new role     
 As Service Manager, you will take full responsibility for leading the service division, driving operational performance, team capability, and customer satisfaction. 
   
 This is a key leadership role balancing people management, technical oversight, and commercial delivery, where you'll play a key role in ensuring service quality, profitability, and long-term client partnerships. 
   
 Key responsibilities include: 
 
 Leading and developing a team of field service technicians, workshop operators, and supervisors, ensuring high performance and engagement 
 Managing service operations end-to-end, including scheduling, resource allocation, and job execution 
 Overseeing maintenance, overhauls, and repairs of compressors and rotating equipment 
 Driving safety-first culture and ensuring compliance with all relevant standards and procedures 
 Building and maintaining strong relationships with key customers, acting as the escalation point when required 
 Identifying and delivering operational improvements to increase efficiency, utilisation, and service delivery outcomes 
 
   What you'll need to succeed     
 You're an experienced leader within industrial or technical service environments, known for your ability to drive performance, build capable teams, and deliver strong commercial outcomes. 
   
 You don't just manage operations, you lead with intent, think strategically, and continuously look for ways to improve service delivery, efficiency, and profitability. 
   
 You will bring: 
 
 Proven experience in a Service Manager or senior leadership role within industrial, mechanical, or engineering environments 
 Trade qualification in Fitting, Machining, or a related discipline 
 Strong working knowledge of service management systems, ERP platforms, and scheduling tools 
 Exposure to Oil & Gas or similar heavy industry sectors (highly regarded) 
 Solid technical expertise across compressors, rotating equipment, or comparable mechanical systems 
 Demonstrated leadership capability, with a track record of coaching, developing, and holding teams accountable 
 A strong commitment to safety, compliance, and quality standards 
 The ability to build trust and credibility with both internal stakeholders and external clients 
 Sound commercial acumen, with the ability to identify opportunities to improve performance, revenue, and service outcomes 
 Highly developed organisational and problem-solving skills, with the ability to perform under pressure in a fast-paced service environment 
 
   What you'll get in return     
 
 Opportunity to step into a critical leadership role within a globally backed organisation 
 Autonomy to shape and improve service operations 
 Competitive salary package with long-term career progression opportunities 
 Exposure to major industrial clients and technically complex equipment 
 A supportive but performance-driven culture focused on safety and excellence 
 
   What you need to do now     
 If you're interested in this role, click 'apply now' to forward an up-to-date copy of your resume. If you have any queries, then please contact Nico van Oudenaaren; nico.vanoudenaaren@hays.com.au, +61 7 5313 8256 
      Please  click here  to apply.
